# Rocky Mountain Hiking Trails

> > Comprehensive hiking trail guides for Rocky Mountain National Park and surrounding Colorado wilderness areas, featuring detailed route descriptions, difficulty ratings, and trail conditions.

Rocky Mountain Hiking Trails provides curated hiking guides for RMNP's diverse trail network, from easy lakeside loops to strenuous alpine summits. The site covers trails in Bear Lake, Wild Basin, Glacier Gorge, Kawuneeche Valley, and nearby wilderness areas including Never Summer Mountains, Flat Tops, and Curecanti National Recreation Area.

## Key Topics

- Rocky Mountain National Park (RMNP)
- Bear Lake
- Wild Basin
- Glacier Gorge
- Longs Peak
- Kawuneeche Valley
- Estes Park
- Alpine lake hikes
- Strenuous hikes
- Easy hikes
- Waterfall hikes
- Wildlife viewing
- Loop trails
- Trail guides
- Colorado fourteeners

## Trail Directory & Planning

- [Rocky Mountain National Park Trails](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/rocky-mountain-trails.htm): Trail directory for RMNP organized by location and difficulty
- [The Best Easy Day Hikes in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/rocky-mountain-best-easy-hikes.htm): Curated list of best beginner-friendly hikes in RMNP

## Popular Bear Lake Area Trails

- [Bear Lake - Hike the Bear Lake Loop in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/bear-lake-nature-trail.htm): Easy interpretive loop around iconic Bear Lake in RMNP
- [Four Lakes Loop: Hike visits 4 lakes in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/four-lakes-loop.htm): 5.6-mile loop visiting Bear, Nymph, Dream Lakes & Alberta Falls
- [Andrews Tarn - Hike to Andrews Glacier in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/andrews-tarn.htm): Strenuous alpine lake hike to Andrews Glacier in Glacier Gorge

## Wild Basin & East Side Trails

- [Copeland Falls: Hike to Copeland Falls in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/copeland-falls.htm): Easy waterfall hike in Wild Basin area of RMNP
- [Sandbeach Lake: Hike to Sandbeach Lake in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/sandbeach-lake.htm): Strenuous Wild Basin lake hike with fall aspen views
- [Lily Ridge Trail - Hike the Lily Ridge Loop in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/lily-ridge-loop.htm): Easy loop around Lily Lake with wildflowers near Estes Park

## Kawuneeche Valley & West Side Trails

- [Coyote Valley Trail - Hike the Coyote Valley Trail in Rocky Mountain](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/coyote-valley-trail.htm): Wheelchair-accessible trail in Kawuneeche Valley with wildlife viewing
- [Hike the Green Mountain-Onahu Creek Loop in Rocky Mountain NP](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/green-mountain-onahu-creek-loop.htm): 7.5-mile strenuous loop trail in RMNP with meadow views & wildlife
- [Lake Irene - Hike to Lake Irene in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/lake-irene.htm): Easy loop trail to Lake Irene near Continental Divide in RMNP

## Advanced & Alpine Routes

- [Odessa Lake - Hike to Odessa Lake from the Fern Lake Trailhead](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/odessa-lake-fern-lake.htm): Strenuous lake hike from Fern Lake Trailhead in RMNP
- [Hike to Battle Mountain in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/battle-mountain.htm): Strenuous off-trail hike to Battle Mountain from Longs Peak Trailhead
- [Hike to West Creek Falls in Rocky Mountain National Park](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/west-creek-falls.htm): Moderate waterfall hike from Cow Creek Trailhead near McGraw Ranch

## Beyond RMNP: Colorado Wilderness Areas

- [Mt. Elbert - Hike North Mt. Elbert Trail to highest point in Colorado](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/mount-elbert.htm): Summit hike to Mt. Elbert, Colorado's highest fourteener
- [Parika Lake - Hike to Parika Lake in the Never Summer Mountains](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/parika-lake.htm): Alpine lake hike in Never Summer Wilderness near RMNP
- [Devil's Causeway - Hike to Devil's Causeway in Flat Tops Wilderness](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/devils-causeway.htm): Narrow ridge hike in Flat Tops Wilderness near Steamboat Springs
- [Sneffels Highline: Hike the Sneffels Highline near Telluride, Colorado](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/sneffels-highline.htm): Strenuous loop trail from Jud Wiebe Trailhead near Telluride
- [Mesa Creek Trail - Hike the Mesa Creek Trail in the Curecanti NRA](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/mesa-creek-trail-curecanti.htm): Short, easy trail along Gunnison River in Curecanti NRA

## Optional

- [Ramble On: A History of Hiking (by Jeff Doran)](https://www.rockymountainhikingtrails.com/history-of-hiking.htm): Book review/info about Jeff Doran's hiking history chronicle
